name: Schlotterbeck & Foss Co
old_description: Handcrafting the Highest Quality Specialty Foods and Flavorings Since 1866
about:
Schlotterbeck & Foss Co. has operated from Westbrook, Maine since 1866, when Augustus G. Schlotterbeck and Charles S. Foss opened a prescription apothecary shop. The partners built a reputation for quality handcrafted products and fair dealings, later expanding into patented medicines and flavoring extracts in the 20th century. The business remains privately held.

Today the company manufactures a range of specialty foods including chef sauces, marinades, condiments, cooking sauces, artisan salsas, spreads, dessert sauces, and dressings. Its core competency lies in product development and proprietary small‑batch manufacturing, using a preparation, cooking, and packaging process designed to retain the shape, texture, and flavor of large‑cut ingredients such as blueberries, corn, mango, and whole garlic cloves. Formulations emphasize organic, non‑GMO, and clean‑label ingredients with no preservatives or artificial colors.

The company serves natural and conventional grocery retailers, club stores, and food‑service operators through private‑label programs and its own branded lines. Customers include leading national retail chains seeking differentiated gourmet products, as well as restaurants and institutional buyers looking for premium sauces and condiments.

Schlotterbeck & Foss traces its differentiation to over 150 years of continuous experience, artisan handcrafting methods, and a focus on ingredient integrity that it says cannot be replicated by competitors.
